Recovered paper collection volume down by more than a million tonnes in Europe in 2023 - EUWID Recycling and Waste Management

# European recovered paper arisings fall by more than one million tonnes in 2023

17 July 2024

Tom Wilfer

The amount of recovered paper collected and utilised in Europe declined again last year. However, both the recycling rate and the utilisation rate increased in 2023. (Stock photo)

European recovered paper collection volumes continue to fall. Last year, a total of 53.7 million tonnes of recovered paper were collected in the region encompassing the 27 EU member states plus Norway, the UK and Switzerland. This is a decrease of over a million tonnes compared to 2022, according to the 2023 "Key Statistics” report published by the Confederation of European Paper Industries (Cepi).

Germany accounted for around half of the decline. The volume of recovered paper collected in the country fell by 500,000 tonnes to 12.7 million tonnes last year.
